heading: Wisconsin DOJ Alleges More Than $1 Million in Medicaid Fraud
summary: State prosecutors charged a Milwaukee woman with allegedly submitting more than $1 million in fraudulent Medicaid claims. The complaint concerns claims the state says she submitted to the Wisconsin Medicaid program. Wisconsin DOJ announced the charges on November 5.

heading: Wisconsin Reports Infant Death Linked to Measles Outbreak
summary: The Wisconsin Department of Health Services reported an infant's death associated with the southwestern Wisconsin measles outbreak. The agency said the coroner listed measles as the immediate cause. DHS said it would withhold further details to protect the family's privacy.
